description: localization and accessibility translation unit. Consumed by locale-check (translation integration); no runtime device use.

context.description: Where the string appears + screenshot/announcement note (synthetic data only)

placeholders.description: Exact placeholder names that must be preserved verbatim

plurals.description: Plural variants when the platform requires them

resource_id.description: Stable Android resource ID, never renamed casually

review_state.description: source edits flip approved/current to stale. critical + unreviewed AI text can never mean fully-supported locale.

source_revision.description: Source-string revision this translation was reviewed against

title: TranslationUnit
